title: Invoices already in QuickBooks Online keep the text they were sent with
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QuickBooks host (for example qb1.qa.shopview.com).
  • The shop has an active QuickBooks Online connection to sandbox company {Sandbox-company-A} (for example ShopView QA Sandbox), and you can sign in to that sandbox.
  • {Sandbox-company-A} holds invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10101) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154721 Fleet), synced from ShopView before this change reached the build, whose line Description was recorded at the time as {Old-text-A} (for example "What are you doing?: Replace tie rod;Why are you doing it?: excessive play;Tech Story: Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to QuickBooks Online and open sandbox company {Sandbox-company-A}.
  2. Open {Invoice-A}.
  3. Read its line Description.
  4. Search the sandbox invoices for {Customer-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the Description still reads exactly {Old-text-A}, the old form with the questions: nothing was rewritten.
  • Step 4: there is no second copy of {Invoice-A} for {Customer-A}: nothing was sent again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-N1, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (What reaches QuickBooks), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-014; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N1: “Invoices already in QuickBooks keep the text they were sent with. Nothing is re-synced, re-exported or rewritten.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given an invoice that reached QuickBooks before this change, then its stored text is not re-sent, re-exported or rewritten.”
